newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila water group to include Mitsubishi.
newsitem.headline: Manila water group to include Mitsubishi.

text.p: A consortium led by Ayala Corp, which won a contract to run Manila's waterworks system, will include Japan's Mitsubishi Group of companies in the project, Ayala President Jaime Augusto Zobel de Ayala said.
He told reporters at the weekend the consortium was still discussing the extent of equity participation for Mitsubishi.

The government had signed contracts with the Ayala-led consortium and with another group led by Benpres Holdings Corp to run the east and west zones of Manila's waterworks system. Each concession is to run for 25 years.
The Ayala-led group includes Bechtel Corp of the United States and United Utilities Plc of Britain while the Benpres group includes France's Lyonnaise des Eaux SA

Benpres chief operating officer J. Xavier Gonzales told reporters the Benpres-led consortium would also include the Philippine Investment and Management Consultants Inc (Phinma), which would hold a 10 percent stake in the project.
The contracts entail $7.5 billion in investments to modernise and expand the water supply and sewerage system for a metropolis of more than eight million people.
Zobel de Ayala and Gonzales spoke to reporters at contract signing ceremony Friday night.
